cases.question: Compare Mac Digital, Drop It, and Amountly.

result.answer:
Mac Digital focuses on website services and AI-generated website concepts: its demo turns a business prompt into copy, optional imagery, and selectable layouts and typography. Its stack includes Next.js, TypeScript, OpenAI, React, and Vercel.

Drop It focuses on saving and retrieving personal content, with a private library for screenshots, files, text, and links, AI-drafted summaries and transcription, and keyword or optional hybrid search. It has a React interface and ChatGPT-compatible MCP server, using TypeScript, Express, and PostgreSQL.

Amountly focuses on financial organization, bringing bills, expenses, invoices, and tax preparation into an accounting workspace with financial search and task-oriented workflows. Its listed stack is Next.js, Vercel, TypeScript, and AI-assisted UX.
